components.name: AccountMenu
components.description: A profile pill that morphs into a full account card.

components.name: ActionMenu
components.description: A dropdown of actions and links with a crafted feel.

components.name: ActivityGrid
components.trigger: in view, then hover, keys and resize
components.description: A white card with a year of daily activity as a heatmap: one column per week, one square per day, in tints and shades of one colour, dark ink by default: light on quiet days, deep on the busiest.

components.name: AddCard
components.description: An empty state for payments: a white card that asks for a first payment card.

components.name: AmountSlider
components.description: A white card for picking an amount.

components.name: AnnotationText
components.description: Hand-drawn pen marks draw themselves around words when they scroll into view: an underline, a circle, a box or a strike-through, each with a slightly wobbly stroke so it reads as drawn, not ruled.

components.name: AuraCard
components.trigger: in view and timeline, plus hover and press
components.description: A feature card on a live two colour gradient: a main pool flows in the lower left and a second colour drifts in from the lower right, blending into it under a moving film grain (on the colour only) while the top stays clear for the title and copy.

components.name: AuthCard
components.description: One white card for signing in and signing up.

components.name: AvatarTestimonial
components.description: A testimonial card driven by a row of avatars.

components.name: BackspaceText
components.description: Types a word, holds, backspaces it letter by letter and types the next, on a loop, with a blinking caret.

components.name: BellToggle
components.description: A pill toggle for notifications.

components.name: BillList
components.trigger: in view, then hover, press and keys
components.description: A white card of upcoming bills and subscriptions.

components.name: BinaryText
components.trigger: hover and focus, plus once in view
components.description: The text scrambles into 0s and 1s, then decodes left to right back into the real characters.

components.name: BlurAccordion
components.description: An accordion whose panels open on a spring and smear with a vertical motion blur while they move.

components.name: BlurText
components.description: Words (or letters) rise out of a blur one after another as the text scrolls into view, settling sharp and in place.

components.name: BookingCard
components.description: A white booking card for a trial class, a demo call or any slot someone reserves.

components.name: BrandBridge
components.description: A feature card for any site or app.

components.name: CalendarAgenda
components.description: A day planner card: a week strip on top and the chosen day's events below, each with its time, length and a colored bar.

components.name: ChannelMix
components.trigger: in view, then hover and press
components.description: A white marketing card: a light gray header with an icon tile, a title and a line of copy, then a white panel that overlaps it with the week's sessions on rolling digits and a row of slim ticks that splits them by channel.

components.name: ColumnCard
components.trigger: in view, then hover, press and keys
components.description: A tall white card with a small live pill, a headline, a short line of body text and a few big rounded columns standing in a soft gray stage over faint guide lines, each carrying its value inside at the top, with a dot legend and the total in a footer.

components.name: ContactCard
components.description: A Contact link that lives inside a sentence ("Not just a simple Contact button."), set in the sentence's own size, weight and colour with just an arrow after it.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description: Wraps any content and opens a white menu at the pointer when it is right clicked, springing out of that corner while its rows rise in.

components.name: ContourFeatureCard
components.description: A product feature card: a browser window with a small dashboard rises in front of a live topographic map.

components.name: ContourLines
components.description: A background of live topographic contour lines.

components.name: DecayCard
components.description: A full-bleed image card with its text laid over the picture.

components.name: DeployStreak
components.description: A white card for a team's shipping streak: a title with an animated flame, a big count of days in a row with a deploy and a grid of dots, one per day.

components.name: DepthCarousel
components.description: A stack of cards receding into depth along a diagonal, each turned a little toward the viewer.

components.name: DeviceTraffic
components.trigger: in view, then hover, plus a live timeline
components.description: A white traffic card: a light gray header with an icon tile, a title and a line of copy, then a white panel that overlaps it with the total visitors on rolling digits and a column per device.

components.name: DownloadButton
components.description: An ink pill that shows a download from start to finish.

components.name: DuoFlip
components.description: A gallery that turns its pictures over with a liquid fold.

components.name: EventCard
components.description: A minimal white card with the details of one event: a small kind line over the title, then the date and a time whose clock hands sweep round to the start when the card comes into view.

components.name: FileDrop
components.description: A white upload card with a drag and drop zone.

components.name: FlipWords
components.description: One word in a sentence flips to the next on a loop.

components.name: FluxCard
components.trigger: in view and timeline, plus hover and press
components.description: A feature card on a pixelated gradient.

components.name: FuseButton
components.description: An action button whose done state carries an undo on a burning fuse.

components.name: GlobeCard
components.description: A feature card, for a team or about page or anywhere else, with a dotted 3D globe rising from its bottom edge over a soft colored glow.

components.name: GoalGauge
components.description: A half-ring goal meter split by source.

components.name: GradientCard
components.description: A metric card on a live mesh gradient.

components.name: GradientText
components.description: A slow gradient flows through the letters on a seamless loop, clipped to the glyphs.

components.name: GravityTagPile
components.description: Tags drop into the card, bounce, spin and pile up under real physics.

components.name: GrowthStream
components.description: A total built up over time, drawn as nested bands that step wider before each checkpoint.

components.name: HighlightText
components.description: A marker sweeps behind chosen phrases one after another as the paragraph scrolls into view, with a slight hand-held skew.

components.name: HoldToConfirm
components.description: A button you hold to confirm.

components.name: InfiniteGallery
components.description: An endless wall of work you can move in any direction and never reach the edge of.

components.name: IntegrationHub
components.description: A ring of app tiles wired into one hub in the middle.

components.name: LiquidCard
components.description: A tall card with a huge icon bleeding off its right edge, used as a glass container.

components.name: LiquidMetalCard
components.description: A white image card that melts into a second picture under a flood of black liquid metal.

components.name: LiquidTabs
components.description: Icon tabs over a white panel, where the chosen tab is a white bump that grows out of the panel's top edge, joined to it by soft inward curves so the tab and the panel read as one piece.

components.name: MagneticButton
components.description: A button that leans toward the cursor on a spring.

components.name: MagneticFlow
components.description: A stack of cards that follows the leader like a snake, then bursts open like the sun.

components.name: MessageComposer
components.description: A white rich text composer for a chat or a comment thread.

components.name: MetalCardStack
components.description: A stack of metal payment cards that feel like the real thing: brushed metal with a fine grain, bevelled edges that catch the light, a visible card edge underneath, an embossed number and a light sheen that slides across the surface as the front card tilts toward the pointer.

components.name: MetricSplit
components.trigger: in view, then hover and press
components.description: A card that splits a total across three metrics: one rounded bar of proportional segments (solid, light, striped), with each metric's dot, label and odometer number under its segment.

components.name: MixChart
components.trigger: in view, then hover, press and keys
components.description: A white chart card of stacked bars, each bar split into a few vivid segments with small gaps between them.

components.name: MonthCalendar
components.description: A white month calendar.

components.name: MorphSearch
components.description: A search pill that turns into a white card on focus.

components.name: OrbitCard
components.description: A feature card for a community, a network or a user count.

components.name: OtpCode
components.description: A white card that asks for a one time code sent to an email address or a phone.

components.name: ParticleCard
components.description: A product feature card whose hero visual is made of particles.

components.name: PaymentForm
components.description: A white card for adding a payment card.

components.name: PillTabs
components.description: Tabs on a tinted track with a white pill that slides to the active tab.

components.name: PixelBlast
components.description: A background of dithered pixel clouds.

components.name: PixelFeatureCard
components.description: A product feature card: a phone with a small app screen stands in front of a field of dithered pixel clouds.

components.name: PixelScroll
components.description: A scroll-driven pixel transition.

components.name: PricingCard
components.description: One plan as a white card resting in a soft grey shell, like a print in a mount, with a label strip along the top of the shell.

components.name: PrismCarousel
components.description: An endless loop of cards, images or metrics, circling slowly through a soft stage that fills its container, with a liquid glass lens at each edge.

components.name: PrismFlow
components.description: A dark background crossed by a soft band of light that bends and drifts like a ribbon caught in slow air.

components.name: PrivacyBanner
components.description: A white cookie consent card.

components.name: ProfileCard
components.trigger: in view, then hover, press and keys
components.description: A white profile card for a creator.

components.name: ProfileMenu
components.description: A white profile menu card for a workspace app.

components.name: ProjectIndex
components.description: An editorial project index: a numbered list of projects beside a large image panel.

components.name: PromptInput
components.description: A white composer for an AI assistant.

components.name: QuotaGauge
components.description: A white card for a plan's credit quota: a three quarter gauge made of radial ticks, like a speedometer, around a bolt.

components.name: RangeChart
components.description: A white card that charts a range for each day, like heart rate: a pill from each day's low to high on a soft column track, separate bubbles for outlying readings, and a dashed average line.

components.name: ReactionCard
components.description: A white post card with three reaction buttons, each with its own pop-up of choices in the spirit of a social feed.

components.name: RecapCard
components.trigger: in view, then hover, focus and press
components.description: A white summary card that reads like a sentence.

components.name: ReceiptButton
components.description: A pay button that turns into a receipt printer.

components.name: RibbonGallery
components.description: An endless ribbon of cards wrapped on the inside of a curved screen and tilted across the frame, 20 degrees by default.

components.name: RoadmapCard
components.description: A white card that walks through the phases of a product roadmap like stories.

components.name: RollingCardStack
components.description: A deck of metric cards that rolls forward like a rolodex.

components.name: RollingStepper
components.description: A number stepper whose digits roll like an odometer.

components.name: RotatingText
components.description: Text set on a circle spins slowly around a center badge.

components.name: ScoreCard
components.trigger: in view, then hover, press and keys
components.description: A white chart card with a big score and a few pill bars.

components.name: SearchModal
components.description: A search field with a card that drops down once it is used.

components.name: ShimmerText
components.description: A bright band sweeps across muted text on a loop, the thinking sheen used for AI and loading states.

components.name: SidebarNav
components.description: A white app sidebar that folds between a full rail of icons and labels and a slim rail of icons only.

components.name: SlideCommit
components.description: A slide-to-confirm pill for actions worth a deliberate gesture: paying, sending, deleting.

components.name: SpatialGallery
components.description: A WebGL media tunnel that turns a list of images and videos into an endless space you travel through.

components.name: SpendingMeter
components.description: A spending card with a segmented bar.

components.name: TabBar
components.description: A white, fully rounded mobile bottom navigation in three styles.

components.name: TeamMemberCard
components.description: A white card for a person on the team.

components.name: TeamMorph
components.description: A presence pill that morphs into a team card.

components.name: TiltCard
components.description: A card that tilts in 3D toward the cursor on a spring, lifts slightly, and catches a glare highlight that slides opposite the tilt.

components.name: TiltCarousel
components.description: A row of photo cards that moves on by itself: the one in the middle faces you square on and every card beside it turns away in 3D, shrinking, dimming and softening a little more the further out it sits.

components.name: ToastStack
components.description: Notifications gathered in a neat stack in the middle of their container instead of a screen corner.

components.name: UsageRing
components.trigger: in view, then press and hover
components.description: A white card for plan usage: a ring made of short segments around a big percent.

components.name: VerifyFlow
components.description: A verification card in three stages: connect, check, verified.

components.name: VoicePrompt
components.description: A composer for an AI assistant that you can talk to.

components.name: WalletCard
components.trigger: in view, then press and hover
components.description: A balance card with a currency switch and quick actions.

components.name: WaveText
components.description: A heading whose words warp like liquid when you touch them.
